headerDisplay: Integrate and control your **Aiper Surfer S2** solar pool skimmer in Apple HomeKit via the Aiper Cloud & AWS IoT MQTT API.
footerDisplay: Note: Aiper's cloud permits one active account session at a time. Opening the official Aiper mobile app may briefly pause cloud polling for ~3 minutes so your phone session is not interrupted.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Display name used in Homebridge logs.

email.title: Aiper Account Email
email.description: Email address used to sign in to the official Aiper mobile app.

password.title: Aiper Account Password
password.description: Password for your Aiper mobile app account.

region.title: Aiper Cloud Region
region.description: Regional Aiper cloud server where your account is registered. Leave on Auto-Detect unless you want to pin a specific region.

deviceId.title: Device Serial Number or Name (Optional)
deviceId.placeholder: Leave blank to auto-discover all Surfer skimmers
deviceId.description: Optional serial number (SN) or friendly name from the Aiper app. Leave empty to automatically discover all Surfer S2 / Surfer skimmers on your account.

accessoryType.title: Primary HomeKit Tile Type

oneOf.title: Switch (Recommended for Siri — 'Turn on Pool Skimmer')
Fan / Impeller (Animated spinning propeller icon + built-in Auto/Manual Clean Path toggle)

accessoryType.description: Choose how the main Surfer S2 skimmer tile appears in Apple Home.

exposeCleanPathSwitch.title: Expose Adaptive Clean Path Switch
exposeCleanPathSwitch.description: Exposes a separate HomeKit switch to toggle between S-Shaped (Off) and Adaptive (On) navigation paths. When Primary Tile Type is set to Fan, Clean Path is also mapped to the Fan's Manual/Auto mode selector.

exposeWarningSensor.title: Expose Problem / Basket Alert Contact Sensor
exposeWarningSensor.description: Exposes a HomeKit Contact Sensor that opens when the Surfer S2 reports a warning (Stuck, Lifted, Debris Basket/Filter Full, Low Battery, or Out of Water), enabling native Apple Home push notifications.

exposeSolarSensor.title: Expose Solar Charging Sensor
exposeSolarSensor.description: Exposes a HomeKit Occupancy Sensor that activates whenever the Surfer S2 is actively solar-charging on the water.

exposeWaterTemperature.title: Expose Water Temperature Sensor
exposeWaterTemperature.description: Exposes a HomeKit Temperature Sensor if your firmware reports water temperature.

enableDoorbellAlerts.title: Enable HomePod Doorbell Chime Alerts
enableDoorbellAlerts.description: Exposes optional HomeKit Doorbell accessories for Skimming Complete and Warning/Stuck events so HomePods can play whole-home chimes.

lowBatteryThreshold.title: Low Battery Warning Threshold (%)
lowBatteryThreshold.description: Battery percentage at or below which HomeKit marks StatusLowBattery.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Cloud Sync Poll Interval (Seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Interval in seconds between background Aiper REST sync polls. Live state updates arrive in real time via AWS IoT MQTT.

debugMqtt.title: Verbose MQTT & API Debug Logging
debugMqtt.description: Logs redacted MQTT shadow/upChan payloads and REST responses at info/debug level for troubleshooting.
